news_bbc.title: People playing loud music on buses could face £100 fine
news_bbc.summary:
Antisocial behaviour on buses in England could lead to fines while a new campaign is also being launched for trains.
A national campaign asking rail passengers "share the carriage, not the noise" is being launched.
